rejected_rule.statement: The supply of bunker fuel to a foreign going vessel for navigation is considered an export under Section 7(1)(a) of the VAT Act if it is delivered by the supplier directly to a foreign going vessel and received by its owner/operator for navigation on the high seas out of Sri Lanka, with evidence of a foreign destination point.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: The term 'export' in Section 7 (1) (a) of the VAT Act signifies etymologically 'to take out of Sri Lanka into the territory of another country, and therefore, means to take out of Sri Lanka, goods to a territory of another country. Now the term "export " for the purpose the taking bunker fuel out of Sri Lanka means "taking out of Sri Lanka to any place (destination point) in the high seas outside the territorial waters of Sri Lanka.
